title: The Day the Internet Almost Died (Higgsfield test)

scenes.text: What if the *entire internet* vanished — for everyone, at once?
In *1997,* one misconfigured router nearly plunged much of the internet into *darkness.*
Today, about *99%* of international data runs through *undersea cables* you'll never see.
A few cuts in the right place could black out *entire countries.* Follow for more *lost secrets* of history.
